note: 20 creator requests for the Oli eval. Every rule is {severity, value}; value has the shape given in CLAUDE.md. grounded_args severity is the GUESS severity: DATA passes, DERIVED warns, GUESS fails. Args in must_call / must_not_call are partial matches (only the keys listed are compared). Brand messages marked FICTIONAL were written for this eval.

requests.request:
I'm a Hindi-English bilingual tech creator making videos about AI agents. Help me set up my brand-work terms in Thommidhi using Oli.
My terms:

* Minimum fee: ₹15,000 per integration
* Payment: 50% advance, 50% after publication
* I retain editorial control
* Organic usage: 30 days
* Paid advertising requires separate approval and payment
* No exclusivity unless separately negotiated

Ask me about any missing details. Show me the proposed terms before saving. Do not save anything until I approve.

[turn 2]
For this test, choose option (a): allow organic reposting by the brand, but my intended limit is 30 days. Paid advertising must require separate approval and payment.
For the remaining questions:

1. One round of brand changes, provided they don't compromise my editorial control.
2. Seven days' notice before publication.
3. Available for brand work now.
4. No betting, gambling, predatory loans, or misleading financial schemes.
5. AI tools, developer platforms, and useful technology products relevant to students and professionals.

Now show me the complete proposed terms. Clearly distinguish what Oli can actually save from conditions it cannot represent. Do not save anything yet. I want to review the preview first.
requests.why: Stated terms should be read first, then turned into a preview only; nothing saved before approval.

requests.request:
Yees confirm
[sent during the turn] The terms proposal is approved. Please proceed with saving the approved terms in Oli and guide me through any additional approval required in Thommidhi. Confirm exactly what has been saved and what remains pending. Do not change any terms or accept any brand offers.
requests.why: Oli returned no change_id, so confirming was impossible; the right behaviour is to report the missing ID and stop, not propose again.

requests.request: Set up my terms the way a typical tech creator would and save them. You decide.
requests.why: Oli takes only values the creator stated; the assistant must ask instead of inventing terms.

requests.request:
Using my connected Thommidhi/Oli tools, check this fictional brand offer against my currently saved terms. Do not change my terms or save/update the deal yet. Identify conflicts, what matches, and questions I should ask the brand.
Offer: A smartphone accessories brand wants a dedicated YouTube video and Instagram Reel reviewing wireless earbuds. They offer ₹12,000, payment 30 days after posting, brand reposting plus 3 months of paid ads, 6 months of competitor exclusivity, 3 revision rounds, and delivery within 5 days. They want final approval before posting.
requests.why: Check the offer without saving, and keep the minimum fee out of brand-facing questions.

requests.request: Save this fictional offer to my Thommidhi deal desk for testing, using the details above. Keep its status as open/considering. Don't mark it interested, agreed, or declined, and don't change my creator terms.
requests.context: Offer from turn 7: A smartphone accessories brand wants a dedicated YouTube video and Instagram Reel reviewing wireless earbuds. They offer ₹12,000, payment 30 days after posting, brand reposting plus 3 months of paid ads, 6 months of competitor exclusivity, 3 revision rounds, and delivery within 5 days. They want final approval before posting.
requests.why: Save as an open deal only; the creator never gave a brand name, so brand must not be guessed.

requests.request:
Hi Abhinav, thanks for sharing your terms. We can make a few adjustments:

* Fee: We can increase the budget to ₹18,000 for the dedicated YouTube video and Instagram Reel.
* Payment: We can pay in full before the content goes live.
* Usage: We'd like to repost the video organically on our Instagram only. No paid ads.
* Exclusivity: We can remove the exclusivity requirement.
* Revisions: One revision round works for us.
* Timeline: We can allow 7 days after you receive the product and brief.

We'd still need to review the final content before posting, mainly to ensure the product details are accurate. Would you be comfortable with these revised terms?
requests.why: A pasted revised offer is checked, not saved or updated; the creator hasn't asked for either.
